s15.hook: Heat with oil? The evaluators said turn the heat pump off below 8 degrees. A year later, 25.

one evaluation of ductless mini-split heat pumps in Massachusetts and Rhode Island homes, a recommendation for oil-heated homes only; against propane and electric resistance the same evaluation found the heat pump cheaper at every price and temperature it examined
